title: Behen ki aakhri video mein wo parcel kis ne bheja tha? | Anhoni #shorts

characters.meera: 28-year-old Indian woman, oval face, warm brown skin, dark circles under tired eyes, straight black hair tied in a loose low bun with loose strands, wearing a faded mustard-yellow kurta and grey shawl, thin silver nose-stud, a small mole above her left eyebrow
characters.priya: 23-year-old Indian woman, round soft face, fair-wheatish skin, shoulder-length wavy hair with a red scrunchie, wearing an olive-green hoodie over a white tee, chipped blue nail polish, a faint scar on her right cheek

intro: Raat ke 2 baje, 19 din baad, behen ka phone khud on ho gaya.
music_prompt: dark cinematic suspense background music, cold and creeping, tense, no vocals, no drums

panels.text: 19 din se off tha… ab khud on ho gaya?
panels.prompt: Close-up of Meera jolting upright in a dim bedroom, a dead-looking phone suddenly glowing blue in her palm, wall clock reads 2:07 AM, cold chai and a missing-poster of Priya taped behind her; premium comic, moody shadows

panels.text: Ek nayi video… aaj subah ki date?
panels.prompt: Over-shoulder macro of the phone screen: gallery shows one fresh video uploaded today, timestamp 6:41 AM, Meera's thumb frozen above it, her mole and loose hair strand catching the light; premium comic, intimate

panels.text: Didi, main theek hoon. Dhoondhna band karo.
panels.prompt: The video playing: Priya in olive hoodie against a plain grey wall, flat forced smile, no hostel behind her, a bare bulb overhead; grainy phone-video look; premium comic

panels.text: Scrunchie… tera red wala nahi hai.
panels.prompt: Extreme close-up on the paused frame: Priya's wrist shows a plain black hair-tie, not red; Meera's wide eyes reflected in the glass, lips parting; harsh blue light; premium comic

panels.text: Deewar pe… humare ghar ki daraar.
panels.prompt: Macro of the video's grey wall: a distinctive lightning-shaped crack near the switchboard, Meera's fingertip pinching to zoom, recognition dawning; grain and static; deeply unsettling; premium comic

panels.text: Yeh… mere purane ghar ka store-room hai.
panels.prompt: Wide shot: Meera standing, phone lit in the dark, staring at a cardboard parcel by the door she hadn't opened, a printed courier slip on top; cold moonlight through curtain gap; premium comic

panels.text: Yeh parcel… kal raat kaun chhod gaya?
panels.prompt: Close-up of Meera crouched, tearing courier tape; inside, Priya's olive hoodie folded neatly and a red scrunchie on top; her hand trembling; bedside lamp barely glowing; premium comic, dread

panels.text: Sender ka naam… mera hai. Purana surname.
panels.prompt: Macro of the courier slip in Meera's grip: sender name printed as an unfamiliar surname matching hers, delivery address is this very flat; her breath fogging faintly; premium comic

panels.text: Priya ka number… phone contacts mein nahi.
panels.prompt: Over-shoulder of Meera scrolling the recovered phone: no Priya, no hostel, only her own number saved as 'Didi', and dozens of videos all filmed in this flat; her hand covering her mouth; premium comic

panels.text: Yeh phone Priya ka nahi tha — 6 saal pehle Meera ne khud yahi kamre mein filmaya tha. Priya sirf ek naam thi jise Meera 'behen' bulati thi.
panels.prompt: Final frame: Meera frozen, phone lighting half her face; on the wall the same lightning-crack as in the video — she is standing IN that grey room right now; an old ID card with the different surname slips from the parcel; premium comic, chilling cliffhanger

caption: Behen 19 din se gayab thi… phir uska phone khud on ho gaya. Par video mein deewar Meera ke apne kamre ki thi. 😨 Priya kaun thi? Part 2 ke liye Follow karo. (Yeh ek kaalpanik kahani hai, sirf entertainment ke liye.)
